visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a restaurant setting with warm lighting, a woman in a white cap and white t-shirt looks surprised with her hands to her face. To her left, a younger girl in a beige quilted jacket claps enthusiastically. A birthday cake with a single lit candle sits on the table in front of them. (2) A man with glasses enters the frame, leaning over the woman in the white cap. They are centered in a medium shot. The woman folds her hands as if making a wish. A small child in a dark blue hooded jacket is now visible seated at the table. (3) The man and woman share a quick kiss while the girl in the beige jacket watches, smiling. The camera angle remains eye-level. The background features a textured wall and a decorative scroll. (4) The camera cuts to a close-up of the young child in the blue hoodie. He has a focused, almost fierce expression. He leans forward and forcefully blows out the candle on the cake. The woman in the white cap looks on with a wide-eyed, surprised expression as the scene ends.
